description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing its contents or other data, primarily for unit testing purposes. It includes functions to load file contents into a buffer and display both the file's original content and provided key-value pair data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into memory and stores it in a provided buffer, along with its length.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if filename provided) and a given KVP data string to stdout, utilizing the read function.
